data.name: First Person Boxing
data.description:
🥊 FIRST PERSON BOXING
Step into the ring and fight from a true first-person perspective! Every punch, slip, counter, and knockout is in your control.

🧠 Slip punches, counter & outsmart your opponent
🛡️ Use different guards to protect your head & body
💥 Land devastating counters for huge knockouts
🥵 Manage your stamina — getting tired slows you down
🎬 Experience cinematic knockdowns & replays
🏆 Fight other players or practice against AI
🎮 PC • Mobile • Console

Master your movement. Find the opening. Become the champion. 🥇
